title: DashboardVisualizationDescriptor
description: A single visualization element in a dashboard: chart, list, or number container. Positioned on the grid via row, order, and width.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: set `type` and then provide the matching payload: `chart` for type chart, `list` for type list, or `numberContainer` for type numberContainer. Do not populate unrelated payloads. Chart and list visualizations require `entityName`; number containers define entityName per KPI item.

name.description: Unique identifier within the dashboard. Prefer kebab-case such as 'events-by-status'.

type.description: Visualization renderer type. Determines which payload property must be populated.

description.description: Optional description text. Can be shown inline or as tooltip depending on showDescriptionAsTooltip.

row.description: Zero-based visual row index inside the dashboard grid. Visualizations sharing the same row are rendered side-by-side.

order.description: Order of the visualization inside its row. When omitted, array order is used.

width.description: Column width: 1 = half row, 2 = full row.

entityName.description: Entity this visualization sources data from. Required for chart and list visualizations; numberContainer items define their own entityName.

globalDateFilterProperty.description: Date/DateTime property used to apply dashboard global date filters to this visualization. Defaults to CreationTime when omitted.

userFilters.description: Interactive filters exposed to end users on this visualization.

property.description: Property name to filter on. Must exist on entityName.

clickToSeeRecords.description: Allow users to click to see underlying records when supported by the runtime.
